description: This PHP class defines the entity 'GroupField' within the OrangeHRM project, mapping to the 'ohrm_group_field' database table. It includes properties with ORM annotations, getters, and setters for managing grouped field metadata.

classes.name: GroupField
classes.description: Represents a database entity for storing grouping field information with properties for ID, name, group by clause, and widget information.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the GroupField entity.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the GroupField entity.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the group field.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the group field.

methods.name: getGroupByClause
methods.description: Returns the GROUP BY clause associated with this group field.

methods.name: setGroupByClause
methods.description: Sets the GROUP BY clause for this group field.

methods.name: getGroupFieldWidget
methods.description: Returns the widget type associated with this group field, if any.

methods.name: setGroupFieldWidget
methods.description: Sets the widget type for this group field.
